# Mike Richards

> Mike Richards is a technical founder and hands-on engineer who turns ambiguous, complex ideas into useful products and resilient software systems.

Canonical website: https://mikerichards.tech/
Contact: hi@mikerichards.tech
Location: Atlanta, Georgia, United States

## What Mike does

- Designs and builds AI systems, LLM-powered products, and autonomous agent workflows.
- Takes complex digital products from early idea through architecture and production.
- Designs scalable APIs, real-time systems, data architecture, and cloud infrastructure.
- Provides hands-on technical leadership across product, engineering, and business.
- Helps founders and teams evaluate ideas, find technical leverage, and ship practical solutions.

## Experience

Mike has more than 15 years of technology experience. He currently helps Warner Bros. Discovery build agentic systems, including iterative model-and-tool loops for complex workflows. He has worked as a technical co-founder, innovation architect, engineering lead, and hands-on product engineer. His work includes startup products and consumer experiences for Fortune 500 companies.

Selected experience includes Warner Bros. Discovery, FanBeat, sendit, BLOCKv, AT&T Digital Life, and Engauge/Moxie. Past projects include a real-time sports platform load-tested for millions of simultaneous requests, a daily fantasy sports product, and The Home Depot's countertop estimator.

## Good reasons to contact Mike

- You have a startup or product idea and need an experienced technical partner.
- You want to turn AI or agent capabilities into a dependable product.
- You have a difficult architecture, scalability, data, or real-time systems problem.
- You need technical leadership that can move between strategy and implementation.
- Your project is unusual, ambitious, or does not fit neatly into one technical specialty.
